consumer.use: Decide whether a future Outcome-Bound natural pilot has a sampling unit precise enough that event arrival, candidate identity birth and supersession can no longer be traded against each other after observation.

decision_target.question: Does candidate_identity_birth, anchored on the canonical identity-first event that itself carries operator_intake, define one sample element without leaving a post-observation degree of freedom?

intervention.name: candidate_identity_birth sampling unit
intervention.description: Freeze the sampling unit as one canonical candidate identity whose identity-first event itself carries operator_intake, order units by authoritative event id, require a complete birth proof before a slot may be used, and treat supersession, enrichment, dedup and idempotent replay as never creating a unit.

control_condition.description: Exactly three terminal predecessor unit-level defects: (1) S1 used event arrival, candidate identity birth and supersession interchangeably, so the same journal supported several different sample counts depending on when the observer looked; (2) S1-R1 M2 did not normalize legacy candidate events without a stored candidate_id before grouping, so the birth anchor of an identity was itself ambiguous; (3) no predecessor imposed a birth-proof obligation, so an incompletely enumerable history could be reinterpreted with a grouping rule chosen after observation.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly U01-U09 in sampling-unit-cases.md, covering pre-boundary birth with later supersessions, post-boundary birth with later supersessions, several births in close succession, content-equivalent distinct identities, incompletely provable history, legacy root with later explicit id, idempotent replay, observer-adjacent operator work, and supersession observed before birth.

measurement.method: Freeze one author revision containing method.md and sampling-unit-cases.md, then obtain a counter-check that independently derives every U01-U09 disposition and slot count from method.md alone and attempts the ten listed escapes. No natural candidate is observed and no pilot is activated.
measurement.success: Every U01-U09 disposition and slot count is reproduced, material_sampling_unit_disagreement_count is zero, no credible escape treats arrival, identity birth and supersession as interchangeable, and no new production field, validator, service or control surface is required.
measurement.falsification: Any changed disposition or slot count, any credible escape, any recovery of a slot from an incomplete birth proof, any skip of a fixed ordinal, or any required production or control surface rejects this revision.

cost_metric.method: Record bounded elapsed runtime of the counter-check as descriptive overhead only.

comparison.unit: terminal predecessor unit-level defect versus one frozen U01-U09 unit case
comparability_constraints: control is exactly the three predecessor unit-level defects above; none is natural evidence
treatment is exactly U01-U09 frozen before any counter-check
S1-R2 canonical identity and natural-source semantics remain unchanged
the activation boundary A and the slot count N are deliberately not chosen here
this experiment creates or consumes no Bureau candidate
confounders: paper cases cannot establish that a live Bureau journal read will satisfy the birth proof
the observed live-register history truncation suggests the proof obligation is not trivially satisfiable today
a counter-check performed by the authoring agent can reproduce its own blind spots
unit precision says nothing about Outcome Case efficacy, prevalence or cost

allowed: terminal S1-R2 method, P01-P18 cases and decision
deployed Bureau canonical candidate identity rule
observed Bureau live-register coverage and truncation report
named counter-check output bound to the frozen author head

reviewed_exception.rationale: The successor is bounded to freezing one sampling unit on paper and takes no natural cases, sets no activation boundary and creates no production or control surface.
